The '''Violet Banyan''' is an area of [[Dim Forest]], [[Huanglong]], slightly north of the [[Giant Banyan]]. It is a large purple tree, reminiscent of a {{w|Salix_babylonica|Weeping Willow}}, with crescent moon shaped lamps hung throughout. The [[Jingle Beast]] is thought to live here.<ref>Lingyang's Companion Story: [[Wild Heart's Return]]</ref>
